He took out his pen and began to write his reply, slowly, so the truth would be kind.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市终于安静下来。路灯在空荡的街口投下昏黄的光，红绿灯仍按时变换，却没有一辆车等待。远处传来环卫车缓慢的轰鸣，扫帚划过地面，沙沙作响。便利店的白光里，店员靠着柜台打哈欠。高楼大多沉睡，只有零星几扇窗亮着。空气微凉，混着面包房飘出的香气。天边还没有亮色，城市已在黑暗里悄悄准备新的一天。", "w03": "- Recursion is when a job is solved by doing a smaller copy of the same job.\n- Think of nesting dolls: you open one doll, find a smaller doll inside, and keep opening until you reach the tiny one that does not open.\n- That last tiny doll is the stopping point, and without it you would keep opening dolls forever."}
